model_annotation: This plot illustrates the composition of sharpness contributions over training steps. The x-axis is labeled “Training Steps” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6400, with tick labels spaced approximately 1600 units apart. The y-axis is logarithmic, starting at 10<sup>-3</sup> and ending at 10<sup>-1</sup>, and displays values for “Sharpness composition.” A single blue line represents the sharpness composition, beginning near 10<sup>-1</sup> at approximately step 0 and rapidly decreasing to a value near 0 at step 1600; the line then rises to a local maximum of approximately 6400, followed by a decline back toward 10<sup>-2</sup> at the end of the x-axis. A second orange line indicates a different sharpness composition, beginning near 10<sup>-2</sup> at approximately step 0, rising to a peak of approximately 6400, and exhibiting a relatively steady decline towards 10<sup>-3</sup> over the course of the x-axis.
